newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.517 billion yuan from Wednesday's 3.774 billion and the most active one was still the 60-day contract.

Traders said that falls in turnover were mainly due to the prevailing expectations of cuts in both bank reserve ratios and bank interest rates, while bullish domestic A share markets continued to support the rates.
The day's listing of Tangshan Steel's 120 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange was another factor supporting the rates, they added.
"But the expectation of cuts in both bank reserve ratios and interest rates in the short term will prevent the rates from rising," said one local trader.
Traders said they expected the rates to consolidate around current levels on Friday.
